title: Image subobjects of ideal powers under closed pushforward
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], let $\mathcal I$ be a quasi-coherent ideal of $\mathcal O_X$, with extended ideal $\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and let $\mathcal G$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Products and powers are those of [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]; pushforward is as in [def-pc-module-pullback]. For each integer $n\geq1$, the image of $i_*((\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z)^n\mathcal G)\to i_*\mathcal G$ equals the image of $\mathcal I^n(i_*\mathcal G)\to i_*\mathcal G$, as subobjects of $i_*\mathcal G$. No quotient comparison or naturality is asserted.

proof.text: For every affine open, the image of a morphism between quasicoherent modules has the same section range as the morphism itself. The abelian image comparison and affine cokernel-image range theorem establish this.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 088A (lemma-existence-tricky), lines 6961-6968; details written out by the worker

proof.text: The range of an ideal-module product on an affine open is the additive subgroup generated by pure products. This follows by identifying the product map with the image of the tensor action and using affine sections of the quasicoherent tensor product.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 088A (lemma-existence-tricky), lines 6961-6968; details written out by the worker

proof.text: For an affine open U of X, the inverse image under the closed immersion is affine and its structure map is surjective. The ideal section formula for comap and Ideal.map_pow identify the pulled-back power with the mapped downstairs power. The affine ideal-times-quasicoherent section formulas then show that the two pure-product generating sets have equal ranges, using surjectivity of the ring map.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 088A (lemma-existence-tricky), lines 6961-6968; details written out by the worker

proof.text: Equality of ranges on the affine basis implies equality of image subobjects. The affine basis detects zero morphisms of modules; each inclusion factors through the other image by the kernel lift of its cokernel projection. Closed pushforward preserves quasicoherence, supplying the hypotheses for the affine range argument.

lean.statement: theorem closedImmersion_idealPower_image {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (G : Z.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : Subobject.mk (image.ι ((Modules.pushforward i).map (idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower (I.comap i).toModulesι n).2 G))) = Subobject.mk (image.ι (idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 ((Modules.pushforward i).obj G)))
